title: MATLAB Discrete-Event System
text: MATLAB discrete-event system; {System object name} sets the full name of the System object™ character, {New} sets the create a SimEvents System object from a template SimEvents System and {Simulate using} sets the simulation mode. Values come from the instance.

params.name: System object name
params.values: Specify the full name of the System object™ character vector

params.name: New
params.values: Create a SimEvents System object from a template SimEvents System object

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify the simulation mode Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
